aer.text: The Renegades are the rebel inventors and citizens of Ghirapur, led by Pia Nalaar, who seize large parts of the city to overthrow the Consulate after the Grand Exhibition at the Inventors' Fair ends in stolen inventions, abducted inventors and violence.
Their ranks swell as the Derby Crows and the Wind-Kin aeronauts join them, and they arm themselves with quicksmith armor, plated airships and raided aether.
With the Gatewatch's help they capture the Aether Hub and redirect its aether to their airship, but the Consulate retakes the hub and they flee aboard the airship.
They then assault the Aether Spire with the Heart of Kiran and a fleet, and after Tezzeret's final defeat the Consulate yields to the Renegades and Pia Nalaar is named consul of Allocation.
